history_boundaries.R80: Already used state-conditioned GRPO over two allocation decisions, actual supervised visual updates, old/tail utility, shared rollout streams and credit-shuffled/long-supervised controls. Merely adding longer rollout, a controller or real parameter feedback is NOT new.
history_boundaries.R83: Already replaced allocation by class-loss-share intervention with same starting visual/AdamW states and disjoint Qa/Qb utility-transfer tests. Real parameter response was not sufficient to establish transferable recognition.
history_boundaries.candidate_difference: A two-slot visual prompt program changes the encoder function applied to BOTH support and query, rather than the class exposure or loss-share of an inner update. Scarcity and class-arrival TRAIN meta-episodes would train a support-based constructor, not rank saved R87/R88/R89 endpoints.
history_boundaries.remaining_problem: A fixed prompt codebook plus a policy can still be ordinary conditional model selection. Its training schedule and witness state must establish something beyond CoCoOp/LIMIT or renamed R80 control. Interface difference alone is not sufficient novelty or efficacy.

synthetic_fixture.description: Two-block3D attention encoder,3classes with one support each,16programs containing genuine no-op (token omission), identical chosen program for support and query. No CLIP or medical data.
synthetic_fixture.limits: Only algebraic action freedom and consistent support/query encoding, not reliable state, cross-component transfer, budget pass or method innovation. Synthetic scale must not be interpreted as percentage-point gain.

cost.why_second_run: First result used an incorrect manually written call count84. Replaced it with actual encode() instrumentation; observed83. Mathematical encoder/fixture unchanged.

decision: Not promoted. Need concrete deployable state, atom-learning gradient paths, independent TRAIN-component episode denominators and full early-encoding runtime/native feasibility before a scientific protocol. Do not repeat these passed toy checks or reopen historical runs.
